description: Lumina Evol-Instruct Seed Library - 100 Industrial Automation Seeds

seeds.prompt: Write a Siemens SCL function block for a 3-phase induction motor with direct-on-line starting, forward/reverse rotation, and a run-time hour counter.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text function block for a variable speed drive (VSD) motor with ramp-up speed control, speed feedback from an encoder, and a thermal overload protection interlock.
Write an Allen-Bradley Structured Text routine for a star-delta motor starter with automatic transition timing, phase failure detection, and a remote start/stop from SCADA via Modbus TCP.
Write a Siemens SCL PID function block for a temperature control loop with anti-windup, bumpless transfer between manual and automatic mode, and output clamping.
Write a Beckhoff TwinCAT Structured Text cascade PID controller for a chemical reactor where an outer loop controls jacket temperature and an inner loop controls reactor core temperature.
Write an Allen-Bradley PID routine for a pressure control loop on a pneumatic system with feedforward compensation from a flow meter and gain-scheduling based on operating range.
Write a Siemens SCL safety interlock function block for a chemical dosing pump with emergency stop, permissive conditions for tank level and flow, and a fault acknowledgment mechanism.
Write a Beckhoff TwinCAT Safety PLC program for a press machine with a two-hand control safety circuit, light curtain integration, and IEC 62061 SIL2 compliant logic.
Write an Allen-Bradley Studio 5000 safety routine for a robotic welding cell with area scanner integration, door interlock monitoring, and a safe-state handler.
Write a Siemens SCL function block for a multi-zone accumulation conveyor with zone-to-zone communication, jam detection via photocell timing, and variable speed control.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text program for a high-speed sortation conveyor with barcode scanner integration, dynamic divert gate control, and throughput OEE calculation.
Write an Allen-Bradley routine for a incline conveyor belt with overload detection, belt slip monitoring via speed comparison, and automatic tensioner adjustment.
Write a Siemens SCL ISA-88 compliant batch recipe manager for a liquid mixing process with ingredient weighing via load cells, timed mixing phases, and batch report generation.

Write a Beckhoff Structured Text batch controller for a pharmaceutical granulation process with temperature profile tracking, end-point detection via power monitoring, and 21 CFR Part 11 compliant audit trail.
Write an Allen-Bradley batch sequencer for a brewery fermentation tank with temperature ramp/soak profiles, CO2 pressure relief valve control, and yeast pitch rate calculation.
Write a Siemens SCL motion control program for a 3-axis Cartesian gantry robot with coordinated linear interpolation, home sequence with limit switches, and collision zone monitoring.
Write a Beckhoff TwinCAT NC/PTP program for a servo-driven cam follower system with electronic cam profile switching, synchronization to a master encoder, and torque limiting.
Write an Allen-Bradley MAOC-based coordinated motion routine for a pick-and-place delta robot with vision system integration for random-bin-picking and dynamic path correction.
Write a Siemens SCL HVAC control program for an air handling unit (AHU) with mixed air control, chilled water valve modulation, supply air temperature reset, and occupancy-based scheduling.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text BACnet-integrated building automation controller for VAV box control with room CO2 demand-controlled ventilation and energy optimization logic.
Write an Allen-Bradley HVAC routine for a chiller plant with multiple chiller sequencing, condenser water temperature optimization, and predictive demand limiting.
Write a Siemens SCL centralized alarm management function block with alarm prioritization, shelving, alarm flood suppression, and OPC UA alarm event publishing.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text fault diagnostics library that detects sensor drift via statistical deviation analysis, logs faults to a ring buffer, and sends email notifications via SMTP.
Write an Allen-Bradley Studio 5000 fault handler for an entire production line with fault code mapping, first-fault capture, and automatic restart sequencing after fault clearance.
Write a Siemens SCL Profinet IO communication handler for a distributed I/O island with watchdog timeout detection, I/O force control from HMI, and hot-swap slot management.
Write a Beckhoff TwinCAT EtherCAT master program that reads distributed IO, manages EtherCAT topology diagnostics, and implements a heartbeat check for all remote slaves.
Write an Allen-Bradley CIP-based Ethernet/IP communication routine for reading and writing tags from a remote ControlLogix chassis over a DLR (Device Level Ring) network.
Write a Siemens SCL function block for a vertical form-fill-seal (VFFS) packaging machine with servo-driven film tracking, seal temperature PID control, and bag-count production reporting.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text program for a multi-lane tablet counting and bottle filling line with vision-based reject control, lane balancing logic, and changeover recipe management.
Write an Allen-Bradley routine for a case erector and packer machine with carton blank detection, glue gun PID temperature control, and pack pattern management.
Write a Siemens SCL SCADA-integrated water treatment plant controller for a reverse osmosis system with membrane pressure monitoring, permeate flow ratio control, and CIP (Clean-In-Place) sequencing.

Write a Beckhoff Structured Text chlorination dosing controller for a municipal water treatment plant with residual chlorine feedback control, turbidity-based dosing compensation, and regulatory compliance logging.
Write an Allen-Bradley wastewater aeration basin controller with dissolved oxygen PID control, blower VFD management, and energy optimization based on diurnal flow patterns.
Write a Siemens SCL body shop weld controller function block for a spot welding robot cell with weld schedule management, electrode wear compensation, and quality data archiving.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text press shop transfer press controller with die protection, tonnage monitoring via strain gauges, and automatic slide adjustment.
Write an Allen-Bradley paint shop conveyor controller for an electrophoretic coating (e-coat) line with immersion time tracking, rectifier current ramping, and tank level management.
Write a Siemens SCL distillation column controller with reflux ratio control, feed tray optimization, column pressure management, and product quality inferential control from tray temperatures.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text exothermic reactor safety system with rate-of-rise temperature detection, emergency quench valve actuation, and SIL2 safety function implementation.
Write an Allen-Bradley batch ethylene oxide sterilizer controller with sub-atmospheric pressure profiling, EO concentration monitoring, and environmental safety gas scrubber control.
Write a Siemens SCL pasteurization controller for a dairy plant with HTST (High Temperature Short Time) flow diversion valve logic, holding time verification, and CIP recipe sequencing.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text bakery oven controller with multi-zone temperature profiling, humidity injection control, conveyor speed synchronization to baking time, and energy monitoring.
Write an Allen-Bradley bottling line controller for a CSD (carbonated soft drink) plant with carbonation ratio control, filler valve sequencing, and container reject tracking by defect type.
Write a Siemens SCL factory energy management system that monitors power consumption per production zone, detects peak demand events, and executes automatic load shedding to prevent demand charges.

Write a Beckhoff Structured Text solar microgrid controller for an industrial facility with PV inverter integration, battery SOC management, grid import/export optimization, and island mode transition.
Write an Allen-Bradley compressed air system optimizer that monitors header pressure, sequences multiple compressors, implements cascade control, and calculates specific energy consumption.
Write a Siemens SCL CNC machine tool controller for a turning center with tool life management, spindle load monitoring, automatic tool change sequencing, and part program management.
Write a Beckhoff TwinCAT CNC grinding machine controller with wheel dressing cycle automation, spark-out detection, workpiece size measurement integration, and adaptive feed control.
Write an Allen-Bradley machining center controller with pallet shuttle system, fixturing interlock management, coolant flow monitoring, and chip conveyor automatic reverse on overload.
Write a Siemens SCL robot cell sequencer that manages handshaking with a KUKA robot via Profinet, coordinates part loading/unloading from a conveyor, and handles robot fault recovery.

Write a Beckhoff Structured Text collaborative robot (cobot) supervisor for a human-robot collaboration station with speed and separation monitoring via safety laser scanners and power/force limiting.
Write an Allen-Bradley fanuc robot integration routine for a palletizing cell with pallet pattern management, layer sheet placement, stretch wrapper interface, and production count reporting.
Write a Siemens SCL gravimetric dosing controller for a multi-component recipe blender using load cell inputs with calibration management, loss-in-weight control, and batch accuracy reporting.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text continuous loss-in-weight feeder controller with refill detection, refill rate compensation, and feeder performance diagnostics.
Write an Allen-Bradley checkweigher integration routine that reads weight data, performs statistical SPC analysis, controls upstream filler adjust signals, and generates shift reports.
Write a Siemens SCL function block for integrating a Cognex vision system via Ethernet/IP with trigger control, result parsing for pass/fail and defect coordinates, and reject actuator timing.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text machine vision inspection controller for a PCB assembly line with component presence verification, solder joint quality grading, and NG board tracking.
Write an Allen-Bradley vision-guided robot routine that receives pick coordinates from a SICK camera, transforms coordinates to robot frame, and executes dynamic pick operations on a moving belt.
Write a Siemens SCL tank farm management system for a chemical storage facility with level inventory management, transfer pump control, automatic manifold valve sequencing, and overflow prevention.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text API 2350 compliant overfill protection system for a petroleum storage tank with independent level sensor voting, high-high shutdown, and test mode.
Write an Allen-Bradley heated fuel oil tank controller with trace heating PID control, pump-around circulation management, viscosity-temperature compensation, and burner management integration.
Write a Siemens SCL boiler plant sequencing controller for multiple steam boilers with lead-lag sequencing, header pressure master control, feed water PID, and burner management interlock.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text cooling tower controller with fan staging logic, basin level control, blowdown conductivity dosing, and approach temperature optimization.

Write an Allen-Bradley compressed nitrogen generation plant controller for a PSA (Pressure Swing Adsorption) system with valve sequencing cycle timer, purity monitoring, and regeneration cycle management.
Write a Siemens SCL conveyor system controller for a mining application with belt weigher integration, material tracking, dust suppression trigger logic, and splice detection.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text flotation cell controller for a mineral processing plant with air flow PID, froth depth level control, reagent dosing ratio control, and recovery optimization.
Write an Allen-Bradley grinding mill controller for SAG/ball mill circuit with load optimization via power draw, feed rate control, water addition ratio, and bearing temperature protection.
Write a Siemens SCL wellhead control unit (WCU) with production choke valve control, downhole pressure/temperature monitoring, sand detection protection, and SCADA Modbus reporting.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text pipeline pig tracking system with pig detector input management, estimated time of arrival calculation, and valve lineup sequencing for pig receipt.
Write an Allen-Bradley gas compressor station controller with anti-surge control, load sharing between parallel compressors, seal gas control, and HIPS (High Integrity Pressure Protection) logic.
Write a Siemens SCL GMP-compliant clean room air pressure cascade controller for an aseptic fill-finish suite with differential pressure alarm management and HVAC fault interlock.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text lyophilizer (freeze dryer) controller with shelf temperature profiling, chamber pressure control via condenser, and primary/secondary drying endpoint detection.
Write an Allen-Bradley autoclave sterilization controller with F0 value calculation, Biological Indicator correlation, saturated steam cycle management, and 21 CFR Part 11 batch record.
Write a Siemens SCL paper machine headbox consistency control system with basis weight feedforward from CD scanner, slice lip position control, and jet-to-wire ratio optimization.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text Kraft pulp digester controller with chip level management, liquor-to-wood ratio control, cooking temperature/pressure profiling, and kappa number prediction.
Write an Allen-Bradley winder reel change sequence controller with tension control during splice, surface winder speed synchronization, and automatic core positioning.

Write a Siemens SCL gas turbine auxiliary controller for fuel gas conditioning with pressure regulation, dew point monitoring, heating to prevent hydrate formation, and filter differential pressure monitoring.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text diesel generator set controller with automatic mains failure detection, engine start sequencing, synchronizing relay interface, and load transfer management.
Write an Allen-Bradley wind turbine PLC controller with pitch angle control, yaw drive management, grid connection sequencing, and vibration-based tower resonance protection.
Write a Siemens SCL continuous casting machine controller with mold level PID control using stopper rod, casting speed ramp management, secondary cooling water flow profiling, and breakout detection.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text induction furnace power controller with impedance matching optimization, melt temperature tracking via thermocouple, and tilt drive sequence for pouring.
Write an Allen-Bradley hot rolling mill tension control system for a strip steel rolling line with inter-stand tension calculation, looper angle control, and thickness AGC (Automatic Gauge Control).
Write a Siemens SCL textile dyeing machine controller with liquor ratio control, temperature profile management, dye injection sequencing, and colour matching feedback from spectrophotometer.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text ring spinning frame controller with speed profile management, end-break detection per spindle via current monitoring, and automatic piecing signal to robot.
Write a Siemens SCL semiconductor wet bench controller for a wafer cleaning station with chemical dispense sequence management, DI water rinse timing, spin dryer control, and N2 purge sequence.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text cleanroom EFEM (Equipment Front End Module) controller for a wafer fab with FOUP load port management, atmospheric robot scheduling, and aligner integration.
Write an Allen-Bradley CVD (Chemical Vapor Deposition) chamber controller with gas flow MFC control, RF power delivery management, chamber pressure control, and process recipe execution.
Write a Siemens SCL data center cooling controller for a CRAC unit with server inlet temperature tracking, economizer mode switching, humidification/dehumidification control, and PUE calculation.

Write a Beckhoff Structured Text intelligent lighting controller for a warehouse with daylight harvesting via lux sensor, occupancy-based dimming, emergency lighting test sequencing, and DALI bus integration.

Write an Allen-Bradley fire suppression system monitor for a Halon/FM200 suppression system with smoke/heat detector voting logic, discharge delay, abort switch management, and post-discharge ventilation.
Write a Siemens SCL predictive maintenance function block for a centrifugal pump that calculates vibration RMS, spectral envelope alarm, bearing temperature trending, and MTBF estimation.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text gear health monitoring block that calculates gear mesh frequency, tracks amplitude trends over time, and generates a condition-based maintenance work order flag.
Write an Allen-Bradley conveyor belt condition monitoring routine that tracks belt elongation via tension and speed comparison, splice tension peak logging, and automated tensioner adjustment.

Write a Siemens SCL IEC 62443-compliant OPC UA server security monitor that tracks failed authentication attempts, enforces session timeout, logs security events, and triggers network isolation on breach detection.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text PLC code integrity checker that calculates a CRC32 checksum of the running program blocks at startup and compares against a stored golden hash, alarming on mismatch.
Write an Allen-Bradley network anomaly detector that monitors Ethernet/IP traffic counters, flags unusual command patterns (e.g. unexpected explicit messaging to outputs), and triggers a safety hold.
Write a Siemens SCL function block that publishes real-time machine state, counters, and alarms to an MQTT broker for a digital twin synchronization pipeline with OEE calculation.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text OPC UA publisher that maps internal PLC tags to a standardized OPC UA for Machinery (OPC UA 40001) namespace for integration with a cloud-based digital twin.

Write an Allen-Bradley FactoryTalk-integrated production data historian function that samples key process values at 1-second intervals, compresses data with deadband filtering, and publishes to a time-series database.
Write a Siemens SCL Model Predictive Control (MPC) function block for a multi-input multi-output (MIMO) process with a receding horizon optimizer, constraint handling, and disturbance rejection.
Write a Beckhoff Structured Text Kalman Filter implementation for sensor fusion of an encoder and an IMU to produce a smooth, drift-compensated position estimate for a mobile robot.
